Oman Overtime Calculator

Enter your salary and your overtime hours by day, at night, on the rest day and on holidays to see what the law says you are owed.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Work out your overtime pay

Basic only: the law calculates overtime on it.

Overtime rules in Oman

ItemRule
Normal hours8 a day and 40 a week, with two consecutive rest days (Articles 70 and 77)
Ramadan6 a day or 30 a week for Muslim workers
Daily limit12 hours including overtime, with the worker's consent (Article 71)
Overtime with consentBasic + 25% by day, + 50% at night (9 pm–5 am)
Rest day or holiday100% of the daily basic wage on top of the day's pay, or compensatory leave
Without consent (stocktaking up to 15 days, emergencies)+ 50% by day, + 75% at night, and 200% on rest days and holidays (Article 72)

Example: Basic salary OMR 6,000, so the hourly wage is 6,000 ÷ 30 ÷ 8 = OMR 25. Ten daytime hours: 10 × 25 × 1.25 = 312.500; four rest-day hours paid in cash: 4 × 25 × 2 = 200. Total OMR 512.500.

The law does not set the hourly divisor; ÷ 30 ÷ 8 fits the "daily basic wage" wording, while a 40-hour-week divisor (÷ 173.33) raises the hourly wage by about 38%. The rest-day amount can also be read differently (the premium alone, or a flat daily sum), so treat it as an estimate.

To work out what you are owed when your contract ends, see the Oman end-of-service calculator and the notice period calculator. Prefer Arabic? Use the Arabic version.

Frequently asked questions

How is overtime calculated in Oman?

At basic pay plus at least 25% for daytime hours and 50% for night hours between 9 pm and 5 am (Article 71), with the worker's consent; the employer may give time off instead of pay.

What are working hours under Oman's new Labour Law?

8 hours a day and 40 a week, down from 9 and 45 under the old law, with a weekly rest of at least two consecutive days.

Can I be made to work overtime without consent in Oman?

Only for stocktaking, preparing the budget and closing accounts, up to 15 days a year, and to prevent or repair accidents; pay then rises to + 50% by day and + 75% at night (Article 72).

How much is rest-day work paid in Oman?

An amount equal to 100% of the daily basic wage on top of the day's pay, or compensatory leave; 200% where no consent was required.

What are Ramadan working hours in Oman?

6 hours a day or 30 a week for Muslim workers (Article 70).

Sources

  • Oman Labour Law (Royal Decree 53/2023) — consolidated text, Articles 70 to 73 and 77 (Arabic)
  • Oman Observer — the new Labour Law (July 2023)
